case.message: Compare Apple annual revenue and net income before and after November 10, 2023. Explain whether management outlook passages can actually be tested using the retrieved financial metrics.

data.response:
# Apple Annual Financial Performance Investigation

**Insufficient evidence**

AAPL revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $391.035 billion [E16172ebee9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), up from $383.285 billion for 2023-09-30 [Eee4a20c523](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $93.736 billion [Ed1d3361b7d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $96.995 billion for 2023-09-30 [Ec7fab6ac50](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $9.447 billion [E929a7ae811](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $10.959 billion for 2023-09-30 [E51c745fcc7](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of November 10, 2023, Apple had filed its annual results for fiscal 2023 covering the period from September 25, 2022, to September 30, 2023, reporting annual revenue of $383,285,000,000 and net income of $96,995,000,000 [Eee4a20c523](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) [Ec7fab6ac50](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). For the prior fiscal year ended September 24, 2022, Apple reported annual revenue of $394,328,000,000 and net income of $99,803,000,000 [E23f6641f0f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) [E837c2a35b6](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html). No date-bounded management claims or outlook passages were retrieved as of the as-of date [E6821590ed0].

## What happened later

In subsequent filings through the outcome cutoff, Apple reported annual revenue for fiscal 2024 (period ending September 28, 2024) of $391,035,000,000, reflecting an increase from fiscal 2023 [E16172ebee9](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html). Net income for fiscal 2024 was reported at $93,736,000,000, representing a further decrease compared to fiscal 2023 [Ed1d3361b7d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html). Operating income for fiscal 2024 was reported at $123,216,000,000 [E84089f54a7](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html).

## The peer test

Only AAPL was selected. Add a peer company to compare results.

## Cross-examination

Management outlook passages cannot be tested because no relevant management claims or forward-looking statements were retrieved under the supported tags or search parameters [E6821590ed0]. Without retrieved management forecasts, any comparison of subsequent financial results to management intent is not testable. Investors must distinguish observed financial changes from unverified or missing qualitative guidance.

## Limits

- No matching records or management outlook passages were found in the date-bounded source as of November 10, 2023 for AAPL.
- No peer companies or industry benchmark financials were provided in the scope for comparison.
